displayPattern: Front-load washer display shows F0 E5
meaning: Off balance: an unbalanced load can lengthen the cycle and leave clothes dripping.
causes: Washer overloaded so clothes cannot move freely
A bulky item washed by itself
diySteps: If the load is not dripping wet, Whirlpool says the cycle finished and only took longer to balance. No action is needed
If the load is dripping, take a few items out so the rest can move freely, and run a Drain & Spin cycle
Do not wash one bulky item alone. Add a few extra garments to a rug or a jeans jacket, then run Drain & Spin
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If F0 E5 keeps returning on a normal mixed load, contact Whirlpool or schedule service. This code is the off-balance fault, not the slow-drain code F9 E1.
